casual1.prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Kyogre (가이오가) personified, water type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as the scene settings below describe; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Her source may add one small accent at most — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as the scene settings below describe, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: mouth smiling while the eyes stay flat and unsmiling, brows level, gaze direct and unwarm
Pose: Pause mid-step and turn the head and shoulders gently back, without twisting the torso unnaturally.
Orientation: camera below subject looking upward; obey selected framing
Scene: A small ceramic teapot in her hands as she turns toward a home lounge sideboard, beside rain-streaked windows and a folded newspaper in late afternoon.
Outfit and props: An opaque deep-blue satin button shirt with an off-shoulder neckline and matching mini-length shorts, red piping and a small white oval clasp.
Category: Create designed, fashion-forward homewear or lounge-life scenes. Avoid plain pajamas and bland static sofa poses. Use believable home-life actions, stylish home fashion silhouettes, and a sensual but natural private-life atmosphere.
Example scene: a satin lounge set of button shirt and shorts, more refined than pyjamas, lounging at home
Framing: Environmental long shot: show the complete woman and enough surroundings to establish the activity and location.
Lens / perspective: 135mm-equivalent telephoto perspective from farther away, with compressed background depth and unchanged anatomy.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
source_influence: balanced — a few source color and marking cues integrated into everyday clothing
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers, the thumb on its inner side, never merged, doubled, mirrored or extra.
